name: Jeannette C. Alvarado
office: Rowland Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Jeannette C. Alvarado is a high school teacher running for the Rowland Unified School District board, Trustee Area 3. She says the school board's role is to make decisions on allocating budgets and approving districtwide curriculum, academic and extracurricular programs, and policies that benefit students, parents and the community.
